scope: All eight cells with V52 baseline / Batch12 / Batch13 candidate / reconstructed vLLM 0.27.1 interleaved in one attempt
sampling: greedy temperature0, original EOS and original request max_tokens
exclusion_policy: none; fail whole attempt, retain every sample and failed attempt
correctness_policy: Riley exact frozen token/text/finish reference; all engine input/output counts and transport exact; cross-engine arithmetic differences recorded
startup_timeout_scope: cold initialization only; captured logs and host samples; excluded from serving timing by explicit warmup and retained phase envelopes
host_clock_bridge: every host sample sandwiches epoch and CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW between perf_counter calls; request clock remains unchanged
batch_changes: Dense-table block ownership/aliasing validation in wire validate, block tables and execution authority (replaces BTree/HashSet/quadratic scan)
Prompt encoding on the submitting thread while the engine has active requests
Word-wise padding scan in the native shape packet validator
host_gate_revision: ORIGINAL gate v1 thresholds: cpu some<=5, io full<=5, memory full<=0.5, 3 consecutive samples within 300 s, otherwise the whole attempt aborts. io_soft_wait_seconds exceeds the timeout so the gate v2 soft path can never trigger.
comparability: same binaries, plan, order and repeats as the gate v2 attempt; separate attempt, results not merged

measured_motivation.source: Batch11 nsys profiles c32-natural/c32-fixed/c1-fixed r0 candidate
measured_motivation.finding: host time between graph replays 16-17% of C32 wall (natural 332us, fixed 121us per decode iteration), ~40% of it prompt tokenization in admit; C1 byte-wise validator scan

diagnostic_runs_before_plan: kernel-batch13-diagnostic-attempt01 single-lane A/B runs guided development; they are not qualifying measurements and are preserved
environment_preparation: page cache of the vLLM venv is read once before launch; startup is outside all timed phases
